items.title: Louie Bellson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: He was there to help James on any arrangements... James was – he behaved like a kid with toys. He would scream and whoop, “Yeah, yeah, yeah. The band, the band, the band, the band.”

ctx.x: Maceo Parker. It was fun because James was in this little booth, and the band was swinging so hard, he would say, “The band, the band, the band, swing it.” We had him yelling and screaming on that. Did you hear that?
No. I’ve got to hear it. I’ve got to hear that. That’s great. He was easy to work with?
